Heart no Kuni no Alice - Wonderful Twin.name: Heart no Kuni no Alice: Wonderful Twin World
Heart no Kuni no Alice - Wonderful Twin.summary: Wonderful Twin World is a continuation of "Heart no Kuni no Alice", and its fandisc.

Puzzle Bobble Pocket.name: Puzzle Bobble Pocket
Puzzle Bobble Pocket.summary:
The famous Puzzle Bobble series made a version ready as a launch title for the PSP.
This title brings the classic puzzle gameplay that the series is known for, with four modes to choose from: Single, Endless, VS and Survival.

Taito Memories Pocket.name: Taito Memories Pocket
Taito Memories Pocket.summary: This was a portable version of Taito Memories that was released for the PSP in 2006.

Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon - Advanced Warf.name: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Advanced Warfighter 2
Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon - Advanced Warf.summary: Building on the foundation of Ghost Recon Advanced Warfighter, the sequel is a near-future warfare masterpiece. Ghost Recon Advanced Warfighter 2 for the PC screams tactics, and you'll need to bring your best to bear if you are going to get the Ghosts past their latest challenge...

World Soccer Winning Eleven 2010 - Aoki.name: World Soccer Winning Eleven 2010: Aoki Samurai no Chousen
World Soccer Winning Eleven 2010 - Aoki.summary: A Japan-exclusive version of Pro Evolution Soccer 2010 which focuses on making a career to go up rankings in the Japanese league.
